name: Special Blend Gardens | Sherb Cream Pie
description: Fruit Stripe, also known as “Yellow Fruit Stripes,” is an indica dominant hybrid strain (70% indica/30% sativa) created through crossing the tasty Lemoncello #10 X London Pound Cake #97 strains. Fruit Stripe high isn’t quite as vibrant, with effects that start out focused before they take a heady turn. You’ll feel creatively inspired from the start as your mind is activated with a budding euphoria and focus. This will soon be overtaken by a potent tingle that will work its way throughout your entire body, helping you to relax while also making you feel totally aroused. Fruit Stripe a great choice for treating conditions such as chronic stress, depression or mood swings, chronic fatigue and chronic pain.
